text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with modest declines, suggesting traders are consolidating rather than committing to a fresh directional move. The Fear & Greed index at neutral (50) with a week-long dip of 9 points indicates sentiment has cooled from prior optimism, while Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 59.4% shows capital remains concentrated in the largest assets rather than rotating to altcoins. Volume at $57B is moderate—neither expansive nor depressed—consistent with a pause phase in the market.
